Got Questions?
FREQUENTLY ASKED
QUESTIONS

Everything GTA homeowners ask about metal roofing.

How much does metal roofing cost in Toronto / GTA?▾
Metal roofing in the GTA typically costs $8–$20 per square foot installed, depending on metal type and roof complexity. A standard 2,000 sq ft home costs roughly $16,000–$40,000. While more expensive upfront than asphalt, metal roofs last 3–5x longer — making them the better long-term investment. Call us at (437) 223-3414 for a free detailed estimate.
How long does a metal roof last in Canada?▾
A properly installed metal roof lasts 40–70 years — far longer than asphalt shingles (15–25 years). Steel and aluminum handle Canada's extreme weather: heavy snow, freeze-thaw cycles, ice dams, and high winds. SteelCrest provides a 50-year product warranty and a 10-year workmanship warranty.
Is metal roofing good for Canadian winters?▾
Absolutely — metal roofing is ideal for Canadian winters. Its smooth surface sheds snow naturally, reducing ice dam formation. Metal handles freeze-thaw cycles without cracking. It also reflects solar heat in summer, lowering energy bills year-round. Many GTA homeowners see their hydro bills drop after switching to metal.
How long does installation take?▾
Most residential metal roof installations in the GTA are completed in 1–3 days. Larger or more complex homes may take 4–5 days. We handle everything — tear-off, underlayment, installation, and cleanup. You won't be left with an open roof overnight.
Can metal roofing be installed over existing shingles?▾
In some cases yes — which saves on tear-off costs. However, we always inspect the existing deck first. If there's moisture damage or rot, a full tear-off is necessary. We give honest assessments — we never recommend unnecessary work.
Is metal roofing noisy when it rains?▾
A common myth! Modern metal roofing with proper underlayment and insulation is no noisier than asphalt shingles. The solid decking absorbs sound effectively. You won't notice any difference from inside your home.
Do you serve my city in the GTA?▾
Yes! SteelCrest serves the entire Greater Toronto Area including Toronto, Mississauga, Brampton, Vaughan, Markham, Richmond Hill, Oakville, Burlington, Ajax, Pickering, Whitby, Oshawa and all surrounding communities. Call us at (437) 223-3414.
Do you offer financing?▾
Yes! We offer flexible financing options for qualified homeowners so you can get a premium metal roof without paying everything upfront. Ask about our financing plans during your free estimate.
